svg.title: Integration Hub architecture
svg.desc: Actual local architecture, from incident logs through verified findings and human-approved recovery. Optional extensions are separated. Animation illustrates flow, not live traffic.

g.text: The architecture behind evidence-backed incident recovery
LOCAL-FIRST AI / VERIFIED EVIDENCE / HUMAN CONTROL
Step / token budgets · one active run
Missing or unsafe evidence → human handoff
Valid finding → human approval → local ticket + reviewed memory
Cloud operation not verified in local mode
Cited hypothesis → human decision → local recovery ticket
Illustrative flow · no automatic production remediation
